title: Pure Memento
summary: Memento cards with generic staples. The page's combo replays add Fiendsmith and K9 cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Memento has had no new cards since Mementotlan Akihiron in mid-2024, so the list is the full 2024 build: the Mementotlans destroy each other to search, mill or summon the next one, Mementomictlan replaces what is destroyed, and the Fusions and Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation recycle the GY into a 5000 ATK boss.
main: Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo
Summons itself from the hand; destroys a Memento to mill Mementos up to its Level.
Mementotlan Angwitch
Summoned: searches a Memento monster; trades a Memento on the field for a Level 2 or lower one from the GY.
Mementotlan Shleepy
Summons itself the turn a monster is destroyed and Fusion Summons a Memento Fusion.
Mementotlan Ghattic
Summoned: returns a Memento card from the GY; summons itself when a Memento mills it.
Mementotlan Goblin
Destroys a Memento to mill two more; discards to shield your Mementos once Combined Creation is out.
Mementotlan Mace
Destroys a Memento to search a Memento card; discards to steal a monster on their turn.
Mementotlan Dark Blade
Summoned: discards to destroy a Spell/Trap; destroys a Memento to summon a Level 3 or lower one from the Deck.
Mementotlan Akihiron
Newest Main Deck card. Destroyed, returns a Memento card; comes back when another Memento is destroyed.
Mementotlan-Horned Dragon
Summons itself with three Mementos in the GY; destroyed, destroys three face-up cards.
Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation
Shuffles five different Mementos back to summon a 5000 ATK boss that summons more on their turn.
Mementomictlan
Field Spell: summons a lower-Level Memento when yours is destroyed, and Sets a Memento Spell/Trap each End Phase.
Mementotlan Fusion
Quick-Play Fusion that can shuffle Mementos from the GY; from the GY, searches a Memento Spell/Trap.
Mementotlan Bone Party
Destroys a Memento to add or summon another from the Deck.
Mementotlan Cranium Burst
Continuous Trap: forces attacks into your Memento and negates a monster effect with Combined Creation.
extra: Three Mementos: mills three Memento cards, destroys a card for each Memento you destroy, and searches the Field Spell.
Two Mementos: destroys a Memento to search two; destroyed, revives one.
